trs.20: By those [winds] sent forth in gusts
trs.85: By the [winds] sent forth in swift succession,
trs.22: By the (Winds) sent forth one after another (to man's profit);
trs.203: By the winds (or angels or the Messengers of Allâh) sent forth one after another.

trs.20: And the winds that blow violently
trs.85: violently storming,
trs.22: Which then blow violently in tempestuous Gusts,
trs.203: And by the winds that blow violently.

trs.20: And [by] the winds that spread [clouds]
trs.85: scattering far and wide,
trs.22: And scatter (things) far and wide;
trs.203: And by the winds that scatter clouds and rain.

trs.20: And those [angels] who bring criterion<sup foot_note=197669>1</sup>
trs.85: separating forcefully,
trs.22: Then separate them, one from another,
trs.203: And by the Verses (of the Qur’ân) that separate the right from the wrong.

trs.20: And those [angels] who deliver a message.
trs.85: delivering a reminder,
trs.22: Then spread abroad a Message,
trs.203: And by the angels that bring the revelations to the Messengers,

trs.20: As justification or warning,
trs.85: as a proof or a warning:
trs.22: Whether of Justification or of Warning;-
trs.203: To cut off all excuses or to warn.

trs.20: Indeed, what you are promised is to occur.
trs.85: what you are promised will come to pass.
trs.22: Assuredly, what ye are promised must come to pass.
trs.203: Surely, what you are promised must come to pass.

trs.20: So when the stars are obliterated
trs.85: When the stars are dimmed
trs.22: Then when the stars become dim;
trs.203: Then when the stars lose their lights.

trs.20: And when the heaven is opened
trs.85: and the sky is torn apart,
trs.22: When the heaven is cleft asunder;
trs.203: And when the heaven is cleft asunder.

trs.20: And when the mountains are blown away
trs.85: when the mountains are turned to dust
trs.22: When the mountains are scattered (to the winds) as dust;
trs.203: And when the mountains are blown away.

trs.20: And when the messengers' time has come...<sup foot_note=197670>1</sup>
trs.85: and the messengers given their appointed time––
trs.22: And when the messengers are (all) appointed a time (to collect);-
trs.203: And when the Messengers are gathered to their time appointed.

translation.text: are gathered to their appointed time

trs.20: For what Day was it postponed?<sup foot_note=197671>1</sup>
trs.85: for what Day has all this been set?
trs.22: For what Day are these (portents) deferred?
trs.203: For what Day are these signs postponed?

trs.20: For the Day of Judgement.
trs.85: The Day of Decision.
trs.22: For the Day of Sorting out.
trs.203: For the Day of Sorting Out (the men of Paradise from the men destined for Hell).

trs.20: And what can make you know what is the Day of Judgement?
trs.85: What will explain to you what the Day of Decision is?
trs.22: And what will explain to thee what is the Day of Sorting out?
trs.203: And what will explain to you what is the Day of Sorting Out?

trs.20: Woe,<sup foot_note=197672>1</sup> that Day, to the deniers.
trs.85: Woe, on that Day, to those who denied the truth!
trs.22: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!
trs.203: Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)!

trs.20: Did We not destroy the former peoples?
trs.85: Did We not destroy the first [of them]?
trs.22: Did We not destroy the men of old (for their evil)?
trs.203: Did We not destroy the ancients?

trs.20: Then We will follow them with the later ones.
trs.85: We shall make the last follow them:
trs.22: So shall We make later (generations) follow them.
trs.203: So shall We make later generations to follow them.

trs.20: Thus do We deal with the criminals.
trs.85: this is how We deal with the guilty.
trs.22: Thus do We deal with men of sin.
trs.203: Thus do We deal with the Mujrimûn (polytheists, disbelievers, sinners, criminals).

trs.20: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
trs.85: Woe, on that Day, to those who denied the truth!
trs.22: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!
trs.203: Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)!

trs.20: Did We not create you from a liquid disdained?
trs.85: Did We not make you from an underrated fluid
trs.22: Have We not created you from a fluid (held) despicable?-
trs.203: Did We not create you from a despised water (semen)?

trs.20: And We placed it in a firm lodging [i.e., the womb]
trs.85: which We housed in a safe lodging
trs.22: The which We placed in a place of rest, firmly fixed,
trs.203: Then We placed it in a place of safety (womb),

trs.20: For a known extent.
trs.85: for a determined period?
trs.22: For a period (of gestation), determined (according to need)?
trs.203: For a known period (determined by gestation)?

trs.20: And We determined [it], and excellent [are We] to determine.
trs.85: We determine [it]: how excellently We determine!
trs.22: For We do determine (according to need); for We are the best to determine (things).
trs.203: So We did measure; and We are the Best to measure (the things).

trs.20: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
trs.85: Woe, on that Day, to those who denied the truth!
trs.22: Ah woe, that Day! to the Rejecters of Truth!
trs.203: Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)!

trs.20: Have We not made the earth a container
trs.85: Did We not make the earth a home
trs.22: Have We not made the earth (as a place) to draw together.
trs.203: Have We not made the earth a receptacle

trs.20: Of the living and the dead?
trs.85: for the living and the dead?
trs.22: The living and the dead,
trs.203: For the living and the dead?

verses.text_uthmani: وَجَعَلْنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ شَـٰمِخَـٰتٍ وَأَسْقَيْنَـٰكُم مَّآءً فُرَاتًا

trs.20: And We placed therein lofty, firmly set mountains and have given you to drink sweet water.
trs.85: Did We not place firm, lofty mountains on it and provide you with sweet water?
trs.22: And made therein mountains standing firm, lofty (in stature); and provided for you water sweet (and wholesome)?
trs.203: And have placed therein firm, and tall mountains, and have given you to drink sweet water?

translation.text: and We gave you to drink

trs.20: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
trs.85: Woe, on that Day, to those who denied the truth!
trs.22: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!
trs.203: Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)!

verses.text_uthmani: ٱنطَلِقُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ مَا كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ

trs.20: [They will be told], "Proceed to that which you used to deny.
trs.85: They will be told, ‘Go to that which you used to deny!
trs.22: (It will be said:) "Depart ye to that which ye used to reject as false!
trs.203: (It will be said to the disbelievers): "Depart you to that which you used to deny!

verses.text_uthmani: ٱنطَلِقُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ ظِلٍّ ذِى ثَلَـٰثِ شُعَبٍ

trs.20: Proceed to a shadow [of smoke] having three columns.
trs.85: Go to a shadow of smoke!’ It rises in three columns;
trs.22: "Depart ye to a Shadow (of smoke ascending) in three columns,
trs.203: "Depart you to a shadow (of Hell-Fire smoke ascending) in three columns,

verses.text_uthmani: لَّا ظَلِيلٍ وَلَا يُغْنِى مِنَ ٱللَّهَبِ

trs.20: [But having] no cool shade and availing not against the flame."
trs.85: no shade does it give, nor relief from the flame;
trs.22: "(Which yields) no shade of coolness, and is of no use against the fierce Blaze.
trs.203: Neither shady, nor of any use against the fierce flame of the Fire."

trs.20: Indeed, it throws sparks [as huge] as a fortress,
trs.85: it shoots out sparks as large as treetrunks
trs.22: "Indeed it throws about sparks (huge) as Forts,
trs.203: Verily, it (Hell) throws sparks (huge) as Al-Qasr (a fort or a huge log of wood),

trs.20: As if they were yellowish [black] camels.
trs.85: and as bright as copper.
trs.22: "As if there were (a string of) yellow camels (marching swiftly)."
trs.203: As if they were yellow camels or bundles of ropes.

trs.20: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
trs.85: Woe, on that Day, to those who denied the truth!
trs.22: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!
trs.203: Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)!

trs.20: This is a Day they will not speak,
trs.85: On that Day they will be speechless,
trs.22: That will be a Day when they shall not be able to speak.
trs.203: That will be a Day when they shall not speak (during some part of it),

trs.20: Nor will it be permitted for them to make an excuse.
trs.85: and they will be given no chance to offer any excuses.
trs.22: Nor will it be open to them to put forth pleas.
trs.203: And they will not be permitted to put forth any excuse.

trs.20: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
trs.85: Woe, on that Day, to those who denied the truth!
trs.22: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!
trs.203: Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)!

trs.20: This is the Day of Judgement; We will have assembled you and the former peoples.
trs.85: [They will be told], ‘This is the Day of Decision: We have gathered you and earlier generations.
trs.22: That will be a Day of Sorting out! We shall gather you together and those before (you)!
trs.203: That will be a Day of Decision! We have brought you and the men of old together!

trs.20: So if you have a plan, then plan against Me.
trs.85: If you have any plots against Me, try them now.’
trs.22: Now, if ye have a trick (or plot), use it against Me!
trs.203: So if you have a plot, use it against Me (Allâh جل جلاله)!

trs.20: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
trs.85: Woe, on that Day, to those who denied the truth!
trs.22: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!
trs.203: Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)!

trs.20: Indeed, the righteous will be among shades and springs
trs.85: But those who took heed of God will enjoy cool shade, springs,
trs.22: As to the Righteous, they shall be amidst (cool) shades and springs (of water).
trs.203: Verily, the Muttaqûn (the pious. See V.2:2) shall be amidst shades and springs.

trs.20: And fruits from whatever they desire,
trs.85: and any fruit they desire;
trs.22: And (they shall have) fruits,- all they desire.
trs.203: And fruits, such as they desire.

verses.text_uthmani: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ

trs.20: [Being told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you used to do."
trs.85: [they will be told], ‘Eat and drink to your hearts’ content as a reward for your deeds:
trs.22: "Eat ye and drink ye to your heart's content: for that ye worked (Righteousness).
trs.203: "Eat and drink comfortably for that which you used to do."

trs.20: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
trs.85: this is how We reward those who do good.’
trs.22: Thus do We certainly reward the Doers of Good.
trs.203: Verily, thus We reward the Muhsinûn (good-doers. See V.2:112).

trs.20: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
trs.85: Woe, on that Day, to those who denied the truth!
trs.22: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!
trs.203: Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)!

trs.20: [O disbelievers], eat and enjoy yourselves a little; indeed, you are criminals.
trs.85: [You may] eat and enjoy yourselves for a short while, evildoers that you are.
trs.22: (O ye unjust!) Eat ye and enjoy yourselves (but) a little while, for that ye are Sinners.
trs.203: (O you disbelievers)! Eat and enjoy yourselves (in this worldly life) for a little while. Verily, you are the Mujrimûn (polytheists, disbelievers, sinners, criminals).

trs.20: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
trs.85: Woe, on that Day, to those who denied the truth!
trs.22: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!
trs.203: Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)!

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱرْكَعُوا۟ لَا يَرْكَعُونَ

trs.20: And when it is said to them, "Bow [in prayer]," they do not bow.
trs.85: When they are told, ‘Bow down in prayer,’ they do not do so.
trs.22: And when it is said to them, "Prostrate yourselves!" they do not so.
trs.203: And when it is said to them: "Bow down yourself (in prayer)!" They bow not down (offer not their prayers).<sup foot_note=155027>1</sup>

trs.20: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
trs.85: Woe, on that Day, to those who denied the truth!
trs.22: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!
trs.203: Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)!

trs.20: Then in what statement after it [i.e., the Qur’ān] will they believe?
trs.85: In what revelation, after this, will they believe?
trs.22: Then what Message, after that, will they believe in?
trs.203: Then in what statement after this (the Qur’ân) will they believe?
